quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 IR deck roadmap extends past the 2026 PCIe 6.0 controller (FC6161) to a PCIe 7.0 (Gen7) controller shown for 2028; the company says that once adopted, its controllers typically ship for 3-5 years (long development cycles, continuous co-development, high switching costs)
